commit.message:
Teach agents to use Access service tokens (#269)

* Teach agents to use Access service tokens

When a non-browser client hits a Cloudflare Access login page, check for
an authorized service token and send its header pair on the original
request. Cover Service Auth policies, secret handling, cross-origin
redirects, and single-header mode. Route these requests from the
cloudflare skill to cloudflare-one.
